title: QBR slate & mid-quarter prioritization — blockers, runway request
text:
QBR slate & mid-quarter prioritization — blockers, runway request

['From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Emily Chen <emily.chen@acmecloud.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: QBR slate & mid-quarter prioritization — initial ask

Team — attaching a light QBR slate (QBR-slate-v0.9.pdf) and a short runway estimate. I pulled together the product-level asks and a proposed prioritization for the mid-quarter check-in. High-level items: 

- Blockers: model regression in 3P quantized path; infra throttling on east-region during peak tests. 
- Ask: temporary reallocation of one T4 pool (2 weeks) to unblock the latency SLO tests.
- QBR deliverable: one-slide impact summary and a short mitigation plan for the infra blocker.

Please review and reply with: (1) what we can realistically commit for the next 30 days, (2) any objections to deferring the second-phase integration with Acme Cloud, and (3) owners for the infra tickets.

Attachments: QBR-slate-v0.9.pdf, runway-estimate.xlsx

Thanks —
Avery
Avery Johnson
Head of Product Operations, Redwood Inference
agar@redwood.com

', "From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Emily Chen <emily.chen@acmecloud.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QBR slate & mid-quarter prioritization — initial ask

Avery — thanks for the concise slate. A few quick notes: 

- I can reassign one T4 node from non-critical batch runs starting Friday; that gets us the two-week burst window you asked for, but we need to formalize the rollback window in case customer peak comes earlier.
- For the model regression, can you quantify how many inference hours were affected last week (for our quality metrics)? If it’s >100h we should consider a patch release.
- Deferring Acme integration: OK from my side if their launch window isn't fixed. Emily, could you confirm your dependency constraints?

I'll add a one-slide impact summary to the deck and tag the infra ticket INF-6721.

Vanessa
VP, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

", "From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Emily Chen <emily.chen@acmecloud.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Sep 2026 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QBR slate & mid-quarter prioritization — infra constraints

Agree with Vanessa's plan but two caveats: 

1) The T4 pool is already promised to a Dedicated customer pilot next week; pulling it will require a waiver and a 50% credit (commercial execs will want to weigh that).
2) If we shift capacity we might push queue pressure to west-region; Ops needs a mitigation plan (temporary burst to east + short-term autoscaler tweak).

Laura — can we get a short commercial note on the likely credit/waiver impact and whether we can trade in extra telemetry retention instead of cash credit?

Markus
Head of Serving Runtime

On Tue, Sep 8, 2026 at 10:03 AM Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com> wrote:
> Avery — thanks for the concise slate. A few quick notes: ...

", "From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Chen <emily.chen@acmecloud.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Sep 2026 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QBR slate & mid-quarter prioritization — commercial fallback

Thanks all — quick commercial context: 

- The Dedicated pilot for the T4 pool is an internal POC for a top-10 prospect; we cannot promise hard capacity reassignments without a conversation with Sales. A temporary waiver is possible but will need a short approval chain (Sales + Finance). Estimated impact: 30% concession on pilot economics if we pull capacity.
- Trade: we can offer extended telemetry retention or a temporary priority lane in exchange for reducing the credit amount. That preserves cash and meets the customer's needs.

I'll coordinate with Sales. Avery, if we plan to ask for a waiver, please send me a one-paragraph justification I can use in the approval note.

Laura
VP, Go-to-market Operations
Redwood Inference

", 'From: Emily Chen <emily.chen@acmecloud.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Sep 2026 08:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QBR slate & mid-quarter prioritization — Acme constraints

Avery / Vanessa — quick update from Acme: our launch is flexible; we can take the integration into a lower-priority sprint if Redwood needs runway. Two asks from our side: (1) a clear timeline for when the integration resumes, and (2) access to the staging test harness (we still need SSH keys). If you defer, we would prefer a 6–8 week reschedule window rather than an indefinite hold.

Attachment: Acme-integration-timeline.xlsx

Thanks,
Emily Chen
Director, Platform Partnerships, Acme Cloud

', 'From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Chen <emily.chen@acmecloud.com>, procurement@pacifichealth.org
Date: Wed, 9 Sep 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QBR slate & mid-quarter prioritization — final asks and owners

Thanks — quick summary and concrete owners so we can close the loop before Friday’s QBR prep call: 

- Capacity: Vanessa to request T4 reassign for 2 weeks (Ops ticket INF-6721).
- Commercial waiver: Laura to open approval request; Avery to provide one-paragraph justification (below).
- Model regression: Markus to scope affected inference-hours and propose either a patch or a hotfix plan (deliverable: short note + roll-forward plan by EOD Thursday).
- Acme integration: Emily will accept a 6-week deferral; Emily to share staging access items and timeline spreadsheet (received).

One-paragraph justification for Laura’s approval note (Avery): 
"We are requesting temporary reassignment of one T4 node for two weeks to complete latency SLO validation in east-region. This short-term capacity change will prevent a significant SLA risk for multiple hosted customers and enable us to validate a regression fix that protects month-end revenue. We propose a rollback within 14 days or earlier if customer peak traffic requires it."

Attachments: security-eval-answers.pdf

Please confirm owners and I’ll fold this into the QBR slide and the exec readout.

- Avery
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference

']
